Public context keys name source parameters. Optional keys may be absent. JavaScript defaults apply to undefined. Source truthiness checks also handle other falsy values. Zero-argument functions have no invocation operands.

Settings reads sample the environment and working directory at their call sites. Validation, client creation, request property or site lookup, default range lookup and storage may therefore use distinct versions. Client caches belong to the module instance. Hits retain creation-time provenance. Misses validate before reading creation credentials. Reset clears all three slots. Previously returned handles retain their provenance.

The toolkit is ESM version 1.0.0 and declares Node >=18.0.0. The TypeScript configuration targets ES2022 with NodeNext module and resolution. Declared and locked versions are @google-analytics/data ^4.9.0 and 4.12.1, @googleapis/searchconsole ^6.0.1 and 6.0.1, @googleapis/indexing ^6.0.1 and 6.0.1, googleapis ^170.0.0 and 170.1.0, dotenv ^16.4.7 and 16.6.1, tsx ^4.19.2 and 4.21.0, and typescript ^5.7.2 and 5.9.3. The lock contains google-auth-library 10.5.0 under googleapis and googleapis-common and 9.15.1 for the google-gax chain. These are manifest and lockfile versions. See skill/scripts/package.json:1–17, skill/scripts/package-lock.json:439–474,975–986,1352–1476,1546–1563,2332–2363 and skill/scripts/tsconfig.json:2–19.

Every client-getter summary can return an existing handle or, after successful validation and construction, store and return a new handle. Search Console v1 and Indexing v3 use separate GoogleAuth constructions with the webmasters.readonly and indexing scopes. An acquisition failure precedes any SDK request at that call site. An SDK failure follows SDK entry and leaves the remote outcome unspecified. Uncaught synchronous errors and rejected awaits propagate. A save failure can occur after payload acquisition and prevents normal return. Earlier writes or remote effects can already exist. The source catch regions explicitly route their own failures.

Each API or orchestration save executes the saveResult boundary with the shown payload, category, operation and optional extra. These callers discard its path. Ordinary writes use replace semantics at the selected path. The public storage utility returns its path. Readers acquire content independently.

Ordinary report and Search Console wrappers preserve the incoming dateRange and omit save, enabling child saving. Report children use the joined dimension names as operations. Search Console children use the joined dimension names and default startRow to 0. The direct runReport summaries return the first SDK tuple element. Search Console query summaries return response.data. Each request uses the receiver and settings versions acquired for that call.

The Skill requires enabled Analytics Data, Search Console and Indexing APIs and a service account with GA4 and Search Console access. It documents project-root .env setup and the analysis, timestamped JSON auto-save, saved-JSON read and Markdown summary workflow. The summary belongs in results/summaries/ and includes data tables, trends and recommendations. These obligations are stated at skill/SKILL.md:8–26,53–64,116–142. Runtime guards reflect the implementation.
